WITH player_postseason_doubles AS (
  SELECT 
    bp.player_id,
    p.bats,
    AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles
  FROM batting_postseason bp
  JOIN player p ON bp.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE bp.double IS NOT NULL
    AND p.bats IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) AS overall_avg_doubles
  FROM player_postseason_doubles
),
indexed_players AS (
  SELECT 
    ppd.player_id,
    ppd.bats,
    ppd.avg_doubles,
    ppd.avg_doubles / oa.overall_avg_doubles AS index_value
  FROM player_postseason_doubles ppd
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
hand_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    bats,
    AVG(index_value) AS hand_avg_index
  FROM indexed_players
  GROUP BY bats
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    ip.player_id,
    ip.bats,
    ip.avg_doubles,
    ip.index_value,
    ip.index_value - ha.hand_avg_index AS index_diff
  FROM indexed_players ip
  JOIN hand_averages ha ON ip.bats = ha.bats
)
SELECT 
  player_id,
  bats,
  avg_doubles,
  index_value,
  index_diff
FROM final_result
ORDER BY index_diff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
